text.body:
% JALAHOMA (14r9-14v6) %
jalahomavidhiṃ vakṣye catuṣpīṭhakramāgatam |
yena homavidhānena śāntikādi prasidhyati || [7.1]
caturasraṃ maṇḍalaṃ kuryāt caturhastaṃ tu gomayaiḥ |
sugandhenopaliptaṃ vai vitānaṃ tatra cojjvalam || [7.2]
samantāc ca dhvajān aṣṭau nānāvarṇasamujjvalān |
caturdaśāṅgulāsyaṃ tu bhāṇḍaṃ lakṣaṇamaṇḍitam || [7.3]
nimnaṃ navāṅgulaiḥ śubhraṃ sapādaiḥ śāntikuṇḍavat |
nirjantusvacchasakṣīranīrapūrṇamahodaram || [7.4]
saṃsthāpya maṇḍalamadhye bhāndān aṣṭau tathāparān |
gandhāmbupūritān dikṣu vidikṣu tatsamān śubhān || [7.5]
cūtapallavitān vastramaṇḍitottamakandharān |
jhaṭitākārayogena jñānaḍākinikānvitān || [7.6]
kṛtvā tu kamalākārān karau kamalamudrayā |
paṭhen mantraṃ tu mudrāyā bhāṇḍasyopari darśayet || [7.7]
oṃ kamalābhe svāhā ||
jalamadhye bhaved bhavet padmaṃ padmasyopari candramāḥ |
candrahūṃkārabījaṃ tu bījaṃ ca jñānaḍākinī || [7.8]
sattvaparyaṅkinī kruddhā hāsyaśṛṅgārasaṃmukhī |
dakṣiṇottaramūlāsyā hastābhyāṃ bibhratī punaḥ || [7.9]
gauradaṇḍadvayaṃ vajralāñchitaṃ maṇḍalānvitā |
satsamāṃ jñānasattvīṃ ca niścārya svaśarīrataḥ || [7.10]
dvibhujāṃ trimukhīṃ śuklāṃ tadvarṇāyudhadhāriṇīm |
bhāvitodakadevyāṃ tu praveśyārghādibhiḥ punaḥ || [7.11]
saṃpūjya śuklakusumais tato mudrāṃ pradarśayet |
kṛtvā muṣṭikarau hastau anyonyaṃ pṛṣṭhayojitam || [7.12]
prasārya tarjanīyugmaṃ tābhyāṃ granthiṃ vidhāya ca |
samayamudrā tu vijñeyā mantro 'py asyāḥ tu kathyate || [7.13]
oṃ samaya tiṣṭha hūṃ |
pūrvoktapūrvabhāṇḍe tu ḍākī ghorī taduttare |
vetālī paścime pārśve caṇḍālī dakṣiṇe sthitāḥ || [7.14]
siṃhī caiśānakoṣṭheṣu vahnau vyāghrī tu jambukī |
bodhavyā rākṣase koṇe ulūkī mārute matāḥ || [7.15]
svakīyabījanirjātā dhyeyā khaḍgādicihnikāḥ |
sarvā viśvābjacandrasthāḥ svasvabhāvena saṃsthitāḥ || [[7.16]
cihnaṃ vā padmacandrasthaṃ likhanīyaṃ viśeṣataḥ |
lekhayed vajraḍākinyāḥ karavālaṃ saraśmikam || [7.17]
% sara[\ms14\verso]śmikam
aṅkuśaṃ ghoraḍākinyāḥ vetālyās tu kuṭhārakam |
caṇḍālyā vajradaṇḍaṃ tu śubhraṃ cihnaṃ tu sarvataḥ || [7.18]
śivādikoṇadevīnāṃ sarvāsāṃ kuliśojjvalam |
viśvāmbhoruhamadhyasthaṃ khaṭvāṅgaṃ ca vinirdiśet || [7.19]
tādṛśyajñānasattvākhyāḥ praveśādividhis tathā |
darśayen mūlamudrāṃ tu mantroccāraṇapūrvakam || [7.20]
vāmamuṣṭiṃ hṛdi kṛtvā tadūrdhvaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ punaḥ |
mūlamudrā tu vijñeyā yoginīnāṃ pradarśayet || [7.21]
oṃ jrūṃ jrūṃ svāhā ||
trilakṣajaptakālena pūrvasevā vidhīyate |
hotavyaṃ cāpy anenaiva sitakuṇḍādipuṣpakam || [7.22]
pratipuṣpakamūle 'pi dūrvāṃ kṣiptvā tu homayet |
dhyātvāmbu ḍākinyāḥ kirīṭe tāḍayet punaḥ || [7.23]
% c wanting, anne jñānaḍākinyāḥ?
uktam ekaikamantraṃ ca japtvā puṣpaṃ kṣipej jale |
raktakaravīrapuṣpaṃ ca pūrvagaṃ nāgakesaram || [7.24]
% d sic? smth with puṃnāgakesaram?
padmaṃ homayet tena sarvakāryaṃ prasidhyati |
ayutahomena sarveṣāṃ viśeṣo 'py atra cocyate || [7.25]
pūrvavaj jñānaḍākinyā kirīṭi aṣṭādhikaṃ punaḥ |
śataṃ jalaculūnāṃ ca pratyahaṃ yadi dīyate |
dhanavṛddhiś ca vṛddhiś ca puṣṭir bhavati nānyathā || [7.26]
niḥsvabhāvaḥ svabhāvajñaḥ sarvabhedavivarjitaḥ |
mudrāmantrasamādhānaiḥ niḥsaṅgo homayet kṛtī || [7.27]
atha vā ||
sveṣṭadevatayogātmā śāntaḥ śāntividhau kṣamaḥ |
pūrvavaddhāritābhāṇḍe tuśāścatādivivartitaḥ (?) || [7.28]
svahṛdi jārutā (?) samyak niṣpādya vajrasattvakam |
vajraparyaṅkasaṃsthānaṃ dvibhujaṃ vajradhāriṇam || [7.29]
vāme ghaṇṭādharaṃ śāntaṃ jñānasattvavimiśritam |
kiṃ tu dikṣv aṣṭabhāṇḍeṣu viśvābjacandramadhyataḥ || [7.30]
śāśvatādikatārāṃ tu (?) cihnāni cintayet kṛtī |
aparaṃ prāgvat sarvaṃ arghahomādikaṃ sṛjet || [7.31]
sādhyo 'pi ca tadā bhāvyaḥ śāntaḥ śubhrāmbarānvitaḥ |
nānābharaṇasaṃpūrṇo ratnapīṭhādisaṃsthitaḥ || [7.32]
prītacetātapatrī vai sudhāsnātaḥ sudhīḥ śuciḥ |
hṛdbījarociṣākṛṣṭalocanādikavṛndakaiḥ || [7.33]
pīyūṣapūrṇakumbhāmbhovarṣābhiś ca nirantaram |
tadaṅgeṣu tataḥ svacchaṃ sarvāṅgakaluṣojjhitaḥ || [7.34]
evaṃvidhavidhānena kṣīṇāyur vyādhito 'tha vā |
ṣaṇmāsābhyāsayogena dīrghāyur jāyate naraḥ || [7.35]
jalahomaḥ || ||
